description: Writes an X (Twitter) marketing strategy for a software project from its public GitHub or GitLab repository, and returns it as a PDF report of about 15 pages. Reads the README, releases, languages and repository statistics, then writes positioning, target audiences, profile and bio, voice and tone, content pillars, eight X post styles with example posts, two threads, twelve ready-to-post tweets, posting cadence, a 30-day content calendar, growth tactics, a launch plan, KPIs and risks. Use it to plan a product launch, developer marketing or social media content for an open-source project or startup. Returns a download link valid for 24 hours and the key lines as JSON. Public repositories on github.com and gitlab.com only; the report is in English.
